artistForm.title: Artist Form
artistForm.intro: We are delighted to welcome you to the OKAMI 2026 edition! Please fill in this form carefully so that we can host you under the best possible conditions. If you do not yet have some of the answers, you can provide them later at this address: booking@okamifestival.com. If you need any additional information, please do not hesitate to contact us at the same address.
artistForm.invitName: Name of your guest (One guest per person)
artistForm.infoRun: Do you need a runner for transport? If so, please specify your needs below
artistForm.setupTime: How much setup time do you need?
artistForm.setup: What’s your setup? What gear do you need, and what will you bring?
artistForm.soundcheck: Do you need soundcheck? Tick if needed.
artistForm.record: Do you agree for your set/live to be recorded? Tick the box if you agree.
artistForm.style: What style are you planning to play at the festival?
artistForm.promoText: Add here the presentation text that will be used for promotion
artistForm.pics: Upload here the photo we can use for festival promotion.
